stops.title: Wo nsɛm
stops.caption: Wo nkitahodie nsɛm.
stops.speech: Wo nsɛm kora wo nkitahodie, w’asɔre baa, ne dibea a wɔde ama wo wɔ asɔre no mu.

stops.title: Wo nhyehyɛeɛ
stops.caption: Ahobammɔ, amanneɛbɔ, kasa.
stops.speech: Nhyehyɛeɛ fa wo password ne akwan a wonam so hyɛ mu, amanneɛbɔ a wonya, ne kasa a Kairos de kasa kyerɛ wo.
